title: Summit's PD-1xVEGF rejected by FDA in lung cancer
snippet: The FDA has denied an approval for Summit Therapeutics’ ivonescimab to treat EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer, blocking the drug’s entry to the U.S. after it became available in China in 2024.

title: Targeting Protein Tyrosine Phosphatases in Cancer: Dual Roles and Therapeutic Implications.
